text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, Trainer!
Let's move fast enough to leave speed lines behind us!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To the long-awaited Manga Exhibition!

Today, having received some spare tickets,
I was visiting the Manga Exhibition with Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Look over there, Trainer!!
Right there! That one!
choice_data_list: Oh, how cute! A goat mascot!
Aw, cute! It's a goat mascot!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's Yagippy from "Cobalt Seekers"!
Heyyy! Yagippy!! I'm a huge fan! Take a picture with meee!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I see. Yagippy's fur is way coarser than I imagined.
Is that official canon? Or just this costume?
choice_data_list: ...Wait, you wanted the photo for reference material?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Insaaaaaaaaaane...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shishizaki-sensei's original manuscripts... they practically radiated light, for real...!!
Not just the character linework. Every single effect line was so precise, so delicate—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was no hesitation. You could tell the final vision was clear even from the storyboard stage...
...Gaaah~~! I wanna draw stuff like that, too!!
choice_data_list: Haha. You can do it! Hang in there!
Haha. You can do it! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! The attention to detail on this backdrop is insane!
You can tell even the cloudy sky was drawn to match the original tone!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It really feels like we're standing inside *Pale Gang*!
...Oh! Trainer, let's reenact that one scene!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm going.
You guys stay put and wait here, curled up on the floor."
choice_data_list: "Wh-What... Why would you go that far?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's my life.
I'll throw it away however I damn well please."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Aaaahhh!
This is so much funnn!!!
choice_data_list: (Seeing her have so much fun makes me happy too.)

text_block_list.text:
After browsing through all the exhibits,
we took a short breather at the adjoining café—

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, attendees! Starting today at 4:00 PM,
we will be hosting a Character Cosplay Workshop on the Main Stage!"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Costumes and props are provided, so please, do join in!
Why not take the stage fully dressed as your favorite character?"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"We still have a few spots available!
Anyone interested, please head over to the reception booth next to the Main Stage—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
I'm totally doing this!
choice_data_list: Whoa... Going on the offensive, huh?
Whoa... Going on the offensive, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Opportunities like this are super rare.
If the chance presents itself, you've gotta dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All for the sake of drawing amazing manga!!
choice_data_list: ...You really are endlessly passionate about manga, aren't you?
...You really are endlessly passionate about manga, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because—if you want to output a compelling story,
you need to build up an internal "stockpile" of experiences first!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I try cosplaying today, it'll definitely come in handy
whenever I draw a character who loves cosplay, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So I have to give it a shot!

Her sheer enthusiasm renders me momentarily speechless. Just like when
she was doing research for her work before, Kiseki's dedication to creation is so pure—
choice_data_list: (...I want to help her out too.)
(...I want to help her out too.)

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, the words just naturally slip out
as I make an offer to Kiseki.
choice_data_list: Mind if I join in on that too?
Mind if I join in on that too?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, of course you can!! —Yay!
You're interested in cosplaying too, Trainer?!

I shake my head slightly at her excited question.
That wasn't really why I wanted to participate—
choice_data_list: I figured it'd make the experience even more fun for you!
I figured it'd make the experience even more fun for you!

text_block_list.text: I thought that by participating, I could offer her my own perspectives and feedback. On top of that—

It would give Kiseki the shared experience of "doing it together."
If it could become fuel for her creative fire, there was no reason not to join.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You'd go that far for me...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Allllright, let's do it!
Let's pull off the absolute best cosplay and blow everyone away!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, what to pick?! Cosplaying from *The Prodigal Blade* sounds awesome too!
I'd love to wear a kimono... But if we're talking pure character devotion...!
choice_data_list: Since we're doing this, pick the character you want to be the most!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Right! That makes total sense!
In that case, let's go with the one that's got my blood pumping recently—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! How do I look?!
I'm Keyra from *Guns & Gunpowder*!
choice_data_list: Whoa, it really suits you!
Oh wow, it really suits you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Do I give off that "Rank #7 Assassin" vibe?
I just love this character so much! Her aesthetic and principles are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the buddy dynamic with Larky—who you're cosplaying as—
is the best! I just know these two are gonna take down the #1 assassin together!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And honestly, Trainer... wow! Look at you, it looks fantastic!
Suits really do look way sharper on adults!
choice_data_list: Y-You think so? Thanks.

text_block_list.text:
I accept Kiseki's praise, feeling slightly bashful.
I've never had the chance to wear a suit this flashy, even for work.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well from now on,
you should totally just wear this to work!
choice_data_list: In a purple floral suit?! My coworkers would freak out!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, guess that's a no~. In that case,
I'd better document what you look like right now!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Our next participants are entering as a duo! From *Guns & Gunpowder*,
please welcome Keyra and Larky!"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh! Both sporting crisp, tailored suits,
truly embodying their in-universe moniker—the 'Bloody Duo'!"

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"And now, give us your best shot!
Hit us with your signature catchphrase!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Did you call your mama to say goodbye?
If not, better make it quick."
choice_data_list: Th-"That's the last act of filial piety you'll ever give."

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! A big round of applause for Kiseki-san
and her Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, Trainer!
That was so much fun! What an incredible experience!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I think I finally understand how cosplayers feel.
It all starts with a deep love for the character—and when that overflows,

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
cosplay becomes one medium through which people channel that devotion!
Standing up on that stage really made me realize that.
choice_data_list: Sounds like it was a wonderful experience for you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Picking the characters, deciding on the signature poses, coordinating our lines...
Every single thing we did together was a blast.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure doing it alone would've been fun too, but—
because I was with you! It turned into an experience far beyond anything I imagined!
choice_data_list: I see. I'm glad then!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Let's cosplay together again sometime!
Next time, at the academy!
choice_data_list: L-Let me think about that one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
....................................Haah!
Whoa, I am seriously in the zone! Am I a genius or what~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Having a truly fun day really gets the creative juices flowing!
And it's all thanks to the Manga Exhibition—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, is it?
Well, that's part of it, sure. But...
"Mind if I join in on that too?"
"Mind if I join in on that too?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to go again with you.
